method: spark-range (ARL Aerodynamics Experimental Facility, 39 shadowgraph stations, 6-DOF fit)
coefficient_note: Zero-yaw axial force coefficient from Table 8 ('Multiple shot group fit aerodynamic coefficients'); the report states CX and CD are approximately equal at the small yaw angles measured. Printed to two decimals.
source_title: Silton, S.I.; Howell, B.E. Aerodynamic and Flight Dynamic Characteristics of 5.56-mm Ammunition: M855. ARL-TR-5182, May 2010
license_note: Cover: 'Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.' U.S. Army Research Laboratory report (17 U.S.C. 105 for the government author's work; measured values are facts). Co-author is a contractor (Data Matrix Solutions), so only the numeric measurements are taken, not text or figures.
verified: Table 8 read three times on 2026-10-11 with different prompts; all rows identical.
use_in_app_reason: Covers only Mach 1.18-2.62: no transonic/subsonic points, so a solver clamping below Mach 1.18 would overstate drag past ~500 m. No matching bullet in lib/data/bullet_library.dart (MKE SS109 is a different bullet; BRL-MR-3476 reports M855 CD0 about 8% above SS109). Kept as a reference record only.
